avoid: generic stock-party cliches (confetti explosion on white)
images with unreadable or misspelled text
anything presented as real client work unless verified
imagery.style: Warm, vibrant, real-party energy. Rich color, soft light, celebratory detail. Gold and jewel tones against deep plum backdrops read as premium; bright candy colors read as playful.

note: Brand identity is NOT final. The logo file is a placeholder wordmark. Do not present the placeholder as the final brand mark in any public surface. When the owner finalizes the logo, replace assets/brand/logo.svg, update this file, and set logo_finalized to true.
